Name: Sweetheart Haley
Author: matthewTian
Description:
Inspired by the “athlete-and-cheerleader” personas of Sam and Haley, this mod gives Haley a fresh look that truly embodies the 'All-American Sweetheart' vibe.

To help Haley get more involved in town life, the mod also adds two new routines to her schedule. You can now find her at Pierre's Seed Shop every Tuesday afternoon and at the Saloon on Friday nights. These new routines are active whether you're dating, married, or just friends, and her dialogue will change to reflect your relationship.

[b]If you prefer to keep her original schedule and only change her appearance[/b], you can easily disable the new schedule (set "Add Dance Schedule" into false) in the mod's configuration menu.

[*]Content Patcher
